Iris (People Ops): Quick note: we've updated the handbook section on mandatory compliance trainings and enrollment rules. This affects Manager Anti-bias, Data Handling, and Security Awareness. Please skim and ack by next Friday.
Ben (Learning): New auto-enroll window opens 2026-08-01. If you are a manager flagged for A/B training, you'll see two items in your learning dashboard. Complete both within 21 days.
Zoe (EM): Quick question: will partial completions count? Some of my team are on rotations and might not finish within the window.
Ben (Learning): Partial completions won't meet the requirement. If someone's on an approved rotation or LOA, managers can submit a deferral request using the deferral form in the handbook.
Mark (Payroll): Heads-up for managers: completion status will be included in the next payroll compliance export. Incomplete mandatory training may block certain reimbursements until resolved.
training-bot: Action: auto-enroll notice sent to employees on 2026-08-01. Deadline: 2026-08-22. Reminder emails at day 7 and day 14.
Iris (People Ops): Process note: ack in the handbook + course completion is required for auditors. Managers will receive a weekly digest of their team's completion rates.
Zoe (EM): If someone fails the quiz, can they retake immediately?
Ben (Learning): Yes	1 retake allowed after a 24-hour wait, up to 3 attempts. We recommend using the study guide linked in the course.
hr-bot: Compliance escalation: managers with >20% non-compliance after deadline will get an automated nudge and a follow-up from People Ops.
Iris (People Ops): We'll host two office hours next week (EMEA-friendly times as well). We'll post invites and FAQ updates in the handbook page. If you need a manager-level bulk deferral, DM me with a CSV of employee IDs.
Zoe (EM): Thanks	will share list for my team.
Iris (People Ops): Final: ack deadline 2026-08-22. We'll also add the change to the monthly compliance snapshot. Thanks everyone.
